notes:
Short summary and call notes:
- Company: Skywell GuideSpace builds in-app guided onboarding copilots for mid-market SaaS.
- Primary goal: replace brittle product tours with conversational, context-aware guides that can call internal tooling (tool calling) and surface product telemetry.
- Workload profile: chat-first agent with 1–3 turn sessions, occasional long context pulls (embeddings retrieval), expected peak concurrency ~180 active users/day for initial rollouts.
- Latency targets: p50 <80ms, p95 <200ms, p99 <400ms for streaming token availability. Need streaming chunks delivered quickly for progressive UI.
- Cost constraints: strict token cap per user session (configurable), want predictable monthly spend; asked for example token caps + throttling strategies.
- Model preference: prefer open-model variants for cost but need Redwood verified perf profiles; want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when latency or quota issues.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs export, KMS integration for key management, and EU data residency for some customers (future requirement).
- POC scope: 2-week hosted API POC: implement streaming chat with function/tool-calls to product analytics, run synthetic load to validate p95/p99 and stable token costs; second phase evaluate Dedicated for guaranteed throughput.
- Quote: "If we can keep streaming UI snappy while capping monthly token spend, we can roll across 3 product lines Q3" - Maya.
- Open questions: how Redwood charges for streamed partial tokens vs. final tokens; whether prefix/KV caching can be exposed to reduce token count for repeated onboarding flows.
use_case_summary: Mid-market product org testing Redwood Hosted API for an in-app onboarding copilot that must deliver consistent streaming latency and support tool calling. Key requirements: streaming with low tail latency, token caps per session, fallback to cheaper model variants, SSO and audit logs. POC will validate p95/p99 streaming latency and cost predictability; if successful move to Dedicated for guaranteed throughput and VPC options.
